correctness.rationale: Spectral rational f(x)=(x²-6x+12)/(x²+6x+12) gives SPD endpoint and row sum 1. Independent symbolic inversion verifies each C5/C6 distance-class numerator and denominator. For C6 the sole potentially negative class is adjacency with -2h q(h)/D(h); Descartes gives unique positive quartic root in (6,7). For n>=6, f(hL)=I-12 L⁺/h+O(h^-2), and cycle resistance double-centering gives (L⁺)_{01}=(n-1)(n-5)/(12n)>0, proving eventual negative adjacent entries for all n>=6. C3/C4 complete multipartite spectral cases give unconditional positivity. Green identity sampled n=6..12 only as corroboration, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: For n>=7 only eventual failure is established, not exact positivity window.
